limitations: Both observed-price contracts are caller-constructed untrusted infrastructure, not validators, results, certificates, attestations, producers, or proof.
proposed_start and proposed_end are Runtime operand roles only and do not establish chronology, direction, wave origin, wave end, pivot, extreme, orthodox end, or completion.
observation_provenance_ref is exact opaque metadata; it does not authenticate a data provider, bar, timestamp, field, source record, or market observation.
The live observation object is its only contract identity; no separate observation ID, timestamp, bar reference, OHLC classification, timeframe, degree, wave label, or family is supplied.

Equal price values and one observation object in both endpoint roles are permitted without asserting validity or invalidity; later source-locked P005/P006 semantics must decide whether they are meaningful.
The contract deliberately exposes no calculated length, span, distance, delta, change, return, ratio, percentage, logarithm, overlap, or direction.

The approved P004-style numeric policy is isinstance-based, so int/float subclasses and IntEnum values are accepted; this transport performs no arithmetic, and future methodology validators must independently validate operands under their own approved numeric contract.
Very large integers for which math.isfinite cannot operate are rejected rather than coerced; no Decimal or string conversion is performed.

Exact common-subject identity is enforced only within one live process; matching IDs, mappings, duck types, subclasses, deserialized records, and reconstructed subjects cannot substitute for that identity.

Frozen slots and single-use constructors prevent ordinary mutation and reinitialization, but hostile same-process reflection, slot-descriptor calls, monkeypatching, object.__new__, object.__setattr__, custom metaclasses, or crafted pickle execution are outside the logical trust boundary.
A caller-controlled prefilled deepcopy memo can substitute an untrusted object; ordinary copy/deepcopy return the same immutable identity, and no substituted object gains certificate authority.
JSON-compatible reports are audit data only; explicitly reconstructed observations and pairs are distinct untrusted identities.
Neither structural-invalidity nor validated-family certification accepts these objects, and the validated-family registry remains empty and sealed.
No P005 measurement basis/endpoints/completion/scale/tie/comparison semantics or P006 orthodox-end/overlap/touch/direction/completion semantics are resolved by this infrastructure.
SUBJECT-BOUND-OBSERVED-PRICE-ENDPOINT-PAIR-V1 is a writable development logical baseline and is not physically sealed.
